newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Stena SAYS P&O cooperation set for July.
newsitem.headline: Stena SAYS P&O cooperation set for July.

text.p: Swedish shipper Stena Line said its planned cooperation with P&O on English channel ferry traffic is set to begin at the start of July.
Stena Managing Director Bo Lerenius told Reuters he expected approval from British authorities for the code-sharing arrangement soon.
"We estimate a decision will be announced at the start of June and we naturally aniticipate a positive announcement," he added.

The cooperation agreement between the two rival operators is their answer to the channel tunnel, which has grabbed around half of cross channel vehicle and passenger traffic. -- Simon Haydon, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1004
